name: Feedbucket REST API
description:
# Introduction

The Feedbucket API gives you programmatic access to your account. Use it to manage projects, feedback, comments, attachments, and related resources.

Subscribe to webhooks when you want events as they happen. If you are connecting AI tools, use our MCP server on its own or together with the REST API.

# Authentication

Authenticate every request with a personal access token.

Create a token in the Feedbucket dashboard under **Account → Access Tokens**, then send it as a Bearer token:

`Authorization: Bearer {token}`

The token must include the `api:use` scope. Requests run as that user and use their current team.

# Rate limiting

The API is limited to **60 requests per minute** per user.

# MCP (Model Context Protocol)

Feedbucket also provides an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for AI tools. See the [MCP documentation](https://help.feedbucket.app/en/article/feedbucket-mcp-server-1iqtu19/).

# Webhooks

Feedbucket can send webhook events for all projects in your account to an endpoint. Events: `feedback.created`, `feedback.updated`, `feedback.deleted`, `comment.created`, and `comment.updated`. See the [webhook documentation](https://help.feedbucket.app/en/article/team-webhooks-b41rqb/) for more information.
